changes.comment: Improve compatibility with modded SugarCube 2.x forks (e.g. Degrees of Lewdity): search the whole data-init guard block for the engine IIFE so unminified builds with prefix statements (window.TWINE1/window.DEBUG) patch correctly, and inject `resolve()` for `LoadScreen.unlock(...)` whether it is a bare statement or a comma-sequence element so `initEngine` resolves and the loader no longer hangs at `Loading game engine`
